cadence_exclusion: start_drift: absolute collector start drift greater than 10 s from the frozen schedule

non_observer_process_busy.statistic: per non-observer process identity: sum over journal rows joined to the envelope of busy_cores * interval_s
non_observer_process_busy.bar_basis: 0.05 core (block_two.smallest_holdable_share) * 600 s; ~7.7 J per 480 s interior at 0.3194 W per busy core (exhibit C8, night 20260922-2100; synthesis 25 withdrew the 0.3125 W figure ruling 10 quoted), above the 5 J claim bar
non_observer_process_busy.observer: top_consumers[].observer == true (recorder run with observer_pid = chain root pid)

observer_floor.statistic: per envelope: session.whole_envelope_observer_cpu_s / (end_stamp.monotonic_before_s - start_stamp.monotonic_before_s); campaign value = sum of whole_envelope_observer_cpu_s over all readable envelopes / sum of their spans
observer_floor.definition: SELF + all reaped CHILDREN, including collector, power recorder, load recorder and census; never subtracted
observer_floor.components: reported per envelope: round_block (sampler worker/census block), load_recorder (30 s covariate recorder), power_recorder_residue (whole minus those two; the 100 ms power recorder's cost, unattributed by PID at this revision)
observer_floor.variation: observer_variation_cores = sample SD over all readable envelopes of the per-envelope share, df = n - 1, cores; REPORTED, not a stop
observer_floor.supersedes: v2 observer_floor_cores summed per-round observer_cpu_s (worker/census block only) and omitted the power recorder; v2 reported 0.0531 (20260922-0217) and 0.0528 (20260922-2100); corrected whole-envelope values 0.176 and 0.159 cores
observer_floor.limitation_sentence: Block two measures the marginal energy of the level on top of this observer, not on an idle machine.

sizing.assumption: independent normally distributed disjoint pair differences
sizing.s_pair: sample SD of retained disjoint differences, df = n - 1

summary: retained disjoint pairs (e1,e2), (e3,e4), ..., (e11,e12); even minus odd interior joules; sample SD and upper 90% bound
overlapping adjacent differences and SD, maximum absolute difference: diagnostics only, never sizing
all single-envelope values and SD, first-to-last retained drift: diagnostics only, never sizing
name every overlapping original adjacent pair with absolute difference above 3 * s_pair; diagnostic only; never exclude by magnitude
whole-round observer cpu-s, self plus reaped children including recorder; never subtracted
recorder journal joined by monotonic support: per-envelope busy-core median/max and clean-machine distribution; covariates only
all named exclusions; partial observations retained; PROVISIONAL, no cutoff authority
